title: A matrix-based spectral method for the numerical approximation of the fractional Laplacian and the fractional $p$-Laplacian of functions defined on $\mathbb R^n$
summary: Given a function $u$ defined on $\mathbb R^n$, its fractional $p$-Laplacian is given by $$(-Δ)_p^su(\vec x)=C_1(n,s,p)\int_{\mathbb R^n}\frac{|u(\vec x)-u(\vec y)|^{p-2}(u(\vec x)-u(\vec y))}{\|\vec x-\vec y\|_2^{n+sp}}d\vec y,\quad\vec x\in\mathbb R^n,$$where the integral is understood in the principal value sense, $p\in(1,\infty)$, $s\in(0,1)$, and $C_1(n,s,p)$ is a normalization constant.
